mission_06: Excellent! You have implemented communication-efficient federated learning with gradient compression. Top-k sparsification and quantization work together to dramatically reduce the bandwidth required for each communication round. With a compression ratio of 0.1 and 8-bit quantization, you achieve roughly 32x compression compared to full-precision dense updates. These techniques are essential for deploying FL on mobile devices with limited connectivity. The key insight is that not all gradient elements are equally important - the largest-magnitude updates carry the most signal, and quantization preserves this signal while reducing precision. Error compensation (accumulating the compression error and adding it to the next round) can further improve convergence.
